jobs.description:
Toyota offers a comprehensive remuneration package, including interesting extra-legal benefits. Toyota provides flexibility to take care of both your career and your personal life by providing hybrid work environment with structural possibility to both work from home & collaborate in the office. 

At Toyota Motor Europe, they are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all. All recruitment decisions are based on the individual and their qualifications along with the job requirements. The selection process is without regard to nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, date of birth, religion, ethnicity, disability or other personal characteristics. Toyota do not tolerate harassment or discrimination as our individual experiences and overall diversity is a key strength. Together, let's have the power to make a positive change and go beyond the ordinary. If you need any specific consideration for the interview process due to disability or any other reason, please let the recruiter know.

Jobomschrijving

Team/division description

Material Engineering division widely contributes to Toyota development activities from vehicle development projects to fundamental research. Our team is committed to develop solutions and to introduce attractive & environment-friendly materials towards circular economy, carbon neutrality and customer happiness.

Your responsibilities
	
• Prepare Purchase Orders, and proceed receiving and invoicing 	
• Process technical reports towards official issuance acc. to our internal process 	
• Prepare and format documents, reports, presentations	
• Establish guidelines and procedures 	
• Actively propose and implement cost reduction and efficiency ideas 	
• Support the team’s digitalization processes 	
• Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments. 	
• Support internal and external communication with stakeholders. 	
• Assist in organizing events, workshops, and team activities. 

Your profile
	
• Proven experience as administrative assistant 	
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.	
• Rigorous and self-disciplined	
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Flemish and French are a plus.	
• A very good knowledge of Excel is required (advanced formulas, pivot table...), and powerBI. A good command of powerApp is a plus.	
• Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive information.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• You have a Toyota DNA, this means:
Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach

Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible

Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation

Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success

• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

Profile
• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

Our client is an established international banking institution operating in Luxembourg, a key European financial hub. The organisation combines a strong regulatory and risk management culture with an ambitious technology and digital transformation agenda. They are looking for a Head of IT based in Luxembourg. 

The organisation fosters collaboration between Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Internal Audit, and Business teams, creating an environment where technology is viewed as a strategic enabler of growth, resilience, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will join a leadership team committed to strengthening governance, enhancing resilience frameworks, and supporting the bank's long-term transformation objectives.

As Head of IT, you will be responsible for defining and strengthening the local technology governance framework while ensuring alignment with business strategy, risk appetite, and Group Technology standards.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the local technology governance agenda and establishing effective governance committees, KPIs, KRIs, and reporting structures.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for technology-related matters involving the CSSF and coordinating regulatory responses, inspections, reviews, and remediation activities.
• Owning the local ICT risk management framework, including risk identification, assessment, reporting, mitigation planning, and ongoing monitoring.
• Providing clear and actionable technology risk reporting to senior management and governance bodies.
• Driving the implementation and continuous enhancement of DORA requirements and digital operational resilience capabilities.
• Overseeing ICT incident management processes, resilience testing, business continuity planning, and disaster recovery exercises.
• Managing third-party technology risks, including outsourced services, cloud environments, contractual obligations, information registers, and exit strategies.
• Monitoring technology service delivery, performance, capacity, control effectiveness, vulnerabilities, and resilience metrics.
• Coordinating internal and external audits while ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
• Collaborating closely with Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Group Technology stakeholders.
• Leading and developing the local technology team while promoting a strong governance, risk, and control culture.
• Supporting strategic technology initiatives, transformation programmes, and regulatory projects across the organisation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced technology leader with a strong background in technology governance, ICT risk management, and regulatory compliance within the financial services sector.

Key requirements include:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in technology leadership, governance, risk, or control-related functions.
• Proven experience within banking, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of the Luxembourg regulatory landscape, particularly CSSF technology-related requirements.
• Demonstrated exposure to regulatory reviews, audits, supervisory inspections, and remediation programmes.
• Experience overseeing outsourced ICT services, cloud environments, and third-party technology providers.
• Strong knowledge of ICT risk management frameworks, operational resilience, cybersecurity governance, and DORA requirements.
• Ability to communicate complex technology and risk concepts to executive stakeholders in a concise and business-oriented manner.
• Experience working within matrix organisations and managing relationships across multiple stakeholder groups.
• University degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
• Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CGEIT, CISSP, ITIL, or ISO 27001 are considered a strong advantage.
• Fluent English & Spanish are mandatory, while French would be considered an asset.
